affiliation: Adams Professor of Political Leadership and Democratic Values
bio: Arthur Isak Applbaum is Adams Professor of Political Leadership and Democratic Values and chair of the Democracy, Politics, and Institutions area. He is the author of Legitimacy: The Right to Rule in a Wanton World (Harvard University Press) and Ethics for Adversaries: The Morality of Roles in Public and Professional Life (Princeton University Press).
